items.title: Robinhood CEO: Tokenization Will Enable 24/7 Trading and “Take Over the Entire Financial System”
items.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev walked into the White House and the CFTC with a bold claim: tokenization is not a niche experiment but the next architecture of global finance. What he wants from regulators could determine whether that future gets built in the U.S. or somewhere else entirely.
